remarks: Welcome to Stonegate! We're excited to announce that "Your Ideal Residential" is back, and we can't wait to share this fantastic opportunity with you!  We invite you to explore this exceptional property, which is now available on the market again-not due to any deficiencies, but as it eagerly awaits its next suitable owner.   Discover a stunning new construction home that combines traditional elegance with contemporary flair. This 2024 gem, crafted by Green Day Construction, a cherished family-owned builder from New Canaan, showcases exceptional artistry and remarkable attention to detail.  Stonegate embodies superior craftsmanship. Imagine textured plaster limestone walls, meticulously crafted through specialized training in Canada, radiating old-world charm. With charming gas lanterns, natural white oak flooring, custom wrought iron railings, designer lighting, and exquisite limestone accents, this home invites you to savor every moment. Three spacious levels are flooded with light, and oversized windows capture morning sunshine and breathtaking sunsets, making every corner warm and welcoming.  Step into your gourmet kitchen- a sophisticated space that will inspire even the most discerning chefs. This culinary haven boasts top-of-the-line appliances, including a walk-in pantry, a dedicated coffee bar, dual dishwashers, a Subzero refrigerator, and a stunning 43-inch La Cornue range and hood that leaves a lasting impression. Your primary bedroom oasis is truly spec
